force_overwrite.description: Whether to force overwriting files installed by other packages (risky).

allow_downgrades.description: Allow downgrading packages to older versions.

no_deconfigure.description: Defer package configuration to a later manual step instead of doing it automatically.

no_scripts.description: Skip execution of maintainer scripts (e.g., postinst, prerm). Not recommended for production.

dpkg_dir.description: Path to dpkg's state directory (contains status, diversions, etc.).

lock_path.description: Absolute path to dpkg's lock file.

foreign_architectures.description: List of additional CPU architectures to support (e.g., ['i386', 'arm64']).

log.description: Path to a log file where dpkg writes status messages (instead of syslog).

no_force.description: Prevent dpkg from unpacking files that would overwrite existing ones.

missing_configure.description: Do not fail if a required dependency is missing (caution: may lead to partial configurations).

force_confdef.description: Automatically choose the default option for new conffiles (non-interactive).

force_confnew.description: Always install the new version of a config file during upgrades (non-interactive).

force_confold.description: Always keep the existing config file during upgrades (non-interactive).

no_force_confmiss.description: Do not install missing config files (do not create new ones).

force_conflicts.description: Allow dpkg to proceed even if it would cause a conflict.

admingroup.description: Group used for dpkg's administrative operations (e.g., 'root').

adminuid.description: UID used for dpkg's administrative operations (typically 0 for root).

admingid.description: GID used for dpkg's administrative operations (typically 0 for root).
